patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with content centered horizontally within a defined maximum width, often utilizing a multi-column grid for feature and card presentation.
A dominant deep navy blue (#022043) serves as the primary background, providing a high-contrast canvas for white text and vibrant warm orange/yellow gradient accents on key headings.
A clear typographic hierarchy with large, bold sans-serif headings for maximum impact, often featuring a gradient fill, paired with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and navigation.
The primary navigation bar shrinks in height and becomes sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down, maintaining accessibility to core navigation links.

Distinct visual separation between content blocks is achieved through alternating background colors, including the primary dark blue, clean white, and a subtle gradient from dark blue to a purplish hue at the page's bottom.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar transitions from a taller, integrated state to a shorter, fixed position at the top of the viewport, gaining a subtle background and shadow for visual separation upon scroll.
Key headings and calls-to-action utilize a text gradient effect, transitioning from a warm orange to a lighter yellow, to add visual emphasis and a premium feel.
A prominent video player is embedded in the hero section, providing a dynamic and engaging visual introduction to the site's core message.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, impactful headings (e.g., ~3-4x body text) with a strong, bold weight, contrasted with a clear, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounded corners on buttons, cards, and input fields
design_tokens.spacing: balanced and generous, especially in the hero and between major sections, creating an airy feel, while content within sections maintains a comfortable density

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, rich dark blue as the primary background, combined with a vibrant, warm orange-to-yellow gradient for key headings, creates a sophisticated yet energetic brand identity. This color pairing, along with the large, bold typography, gives the site a premium, authoritative feel that stands out from typical corporate blue-and-white palettes.
